'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Typed sheet. Deck name '''Tribute to Brad Reinhold'''. Sheet note: Supreme Chancellor Chris plays Angelo's deck. Virtual Block 07.03. Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) is marked Starting Effect; the objective is the starting card. Six tests are written with the objective and are not in the reserve: Great Warrior; A Jedi's Strength; Domain Of Evil; Size Matters Not; It Is The Future You See; You Must Confront Vader. Jedi Levitation is annotated Dagobah, non-V. Projection Of A Skywalker is not marked (V). Shields: He Can Go About His Business (V) and the last printed shield are struck; handwritten replacements are Weapons Display (V) and Yavin Sentry (V). A crossed-out margin list was not entered. Interrupt quantities sum to 23 (header 22); Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated is qty 2. Coruscant is marked Special Edition.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned|Mind What You Have Learned (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
